canonical_data: VS Code workspace files plus per-workspace conversation and tool-call history
current_repo_note: Repository was registered in 2022 as an unrelated project; the current OpenCursor coding-agent product began at v0.0.1 on 2026-07-05, so its accumulated star count predates and overstates this product's track record.
strengths: Broad, reviewable tool set (25 tools) with per-hunk Keep/Undo diffs
Genuine offline path: bundled llama.cpp/Ollama plus local embeddings for semantic search
Flexible provider model spanning subscription OAuth, API keys, and fully local models
weaknesses: The current coding-agent product is about two months old; the repository's multi-year star count reflects an unrelated earlier tool
No independent benchmarking of task completion or reliability yet
Single-maintainer project without a documented governance or support process
why_it_matters: Shows a fully offline-capable coding agent built directly into VS Code's extension surface, an open alternative to cloud-anchored IDE agents.
